text: mittasuttaṃ [162] kiṃsu pasavato 1 mittaṃ kiṃsu mittaṃ sake ghare kiṃ mittaṃ atthajātassa kiṃ mittaṃ samparāyikanti . [163] sattho pasavato 2 mittaṃ mātā mittaṃ sake ghare #1 sī. ma. pavasato . yu. pathavato . 2 sī. pañcasato . sahāyo atthajātassa hoti mittaṃ punappunaṃ sayaṃ katāni puññāni taṃ mittaṃ samparāyikanti . catutthaṃ
